content: useGSAP() from @gsap/react is a drop-in replacement for useEffect/useLayoutEffect that auto-cleans via gsap.context(); implements useIsomorphicLayoutEffect (SSR-safe); empty deps array by default so it only fires once; set revertOnUpdate:true to re-run on dep change; all ScrollTriggers/tweens/Draggables created inside are auto-reverted on unmount.
